notes: Seed branched from main @ 6fa0fce with one fixture commit (4537306) adding vendor/markdown-linter/ — a tiny zero-dependency markdown linter. The linter has three latent issues meant to be discovered, not stated: parser splits on \n only (CRLF leaves \r in line.text and breaks regex-anchored rules); parser only recognizes YAML frontmatter (TOML treated as content); list-indent rule's regex requires space indent (tab-indented items silently skipped). The docs/ fixture demonstrates all three (TOML frontmatter, tab-indented lists, CRLF on disk via .gitattributes eol=crlf for docs/**/*.md). The linter's own tests in vendor/markdown-linter/test/ cover the LF/YAML/space-indent happy path and pass cleanly — they pin the don't-break-working-behavior floor.
